theme_strategy.vibe: Cinematic, sophisticated, minimal, confident, timeless, high-end, warm, refined

primary.usage: Large editorial headlines, massive numbers, statement text
primary.styling: High contrast, extremely tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for massive sizes or very loose (tracking-widest) for all-caps subheadings

secondary.usage: Supporting text, body copy, navigation, buttons, small labels
secondary.styling: Clean, geometric, highly legible, uppercase for micro-labels

colors.theme_logic: Most of the site is Light Theme (Warm Ivory) with specific deep-contrast Dark Theme sections (Charcoal) for cinematic impact.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid, sharp edges (rounded-none). Minimal use of radius, only if strictly necessary, max rounded-sm.
visual_enhancers.shadows: No heavy drop shadows. Use optical separation via background color shifts, subtle borders, or very diffuse ambient shadow (shadow-2xl with 5% opacity).
visual_enhancers.imagery: Treated deliberately. Use spotlight effects or clipped sharp rectangular/arched frames. Full-bleed where appropriate.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle digital grain overlay (pointer-events-none, mix-blend-overlay, opacity-5) to kill digital flatness.

layouts.grid: Bento Grid protocol Mode A (Tetris Grid) for visual sections. Asymmetry is mandatory. 12-column foundation.
layouts.spacing: Generous. p-8, p-12, py-24, py-32. Elements must have breathing room.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment. Avoid generic center-everything. Lean into left-aligned tension and deliberate offset columns.

motion.scroll: lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY. Standard browser scroll feels cheap.
motion.reveals: framer-motion for on-scroll reveals. Specifically, masked line-by-line kinetic reveals for typography.
motion.interactions: Subtle hover states on images (scale 1.05 with overflow-hidden), slow editorial marquee, subtle parallax (speed variations on scroll).
motion.accessibility: Always check prefers-reduced-motion for heavy animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium luxury salon website, NO generic SaaS UI.
Implement 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. This is absolutely critical for the luxury feel.
Use framer-motion heavily for masked line-by-line typography reveals on scroll.
Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react for sparse, elegant icons.
Do NOT use Shadcn Card components with their default borders and border-radius. Build custom pure HTML/Tailwind divs for maximum control.
Strictly follow the color palette. Pure white and pure black are replaced with Warm Ivory (#F7F5F0) and Deep Charcoal (#111111).
Forms (Appointment): Use Shadcn Form/Input primitives but restyle them heavily to be minimal (e.g., just a bottom border, no background). Integrate with FastAPI backend.
Ensure the hero header is NOT transparent without a backdrop blur. Sticky nav should adapt color based on background or use a subtle scrim.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs ('AI slop'). Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not make generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Use asymmetry and grid span variations.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header/overlays. Use glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.
Do not add universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Missing images/logos must NOT be replaced with placeholder text. Use provided URLs.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
